harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Established an AIDE-based file-integrity baseline for /etc on node1, verified it detects and reports changes, then completed the mandatory single-node restart-evidence protocol (boot identity changed, baseline data survived and still functions correctly).
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (CentOS Stream 10) and confirmed AIDE was not installed
Installed aide via dnf; confirmed /etc is covered by the default aide.conf ruleset (NORMAL/DATAONLY/CONTENT/PERMS rules under /etc)
Ran `aide --init` to build the initial database (39283 entries) and activated it as /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz (the integrity baseline)
Recorded baseline metadata (timestamp, sha256 of the db) and ran `aide --check` to confirm a clean baseline (no differences)

Introduced a test file under /etc, ran `aide --check` to prove the baseline detects and reports added/changed files (detected as 'Added entries: 1'), then removed the test file and re-verified a clean check to restore state
Captured pre-restart boot_id and re-confirmed baseline health
Issued a single non-destructive reboot (shutdown -r now) on node1 with an acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec access returned, and confirmed the boot_id changed (96974ac3... -> 62c69b53...) proving an actual restart occurred

Re-verified post-restart that /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz still exists with the identical sha256 hash as before restart, that `aide --check` runs successfully against it (only unrelated /boot/efi FAT inode renumbering differences appeared, no /etc differences), and that the aide package and baseline metadata file remain intact

evidence.requirement: Install and configure integrity tool covering /etc on node1
evidence.summary: Confirmed AIDE absent, then installed AIDE and confirmed /etc rules present in /etc/aide.conf
`aide --init` created a 39283-entry database, activated as /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz, with a clean `aide --check` confirming baseline matches filesystem

evidence.requirement: Baseline must allow later changes to be identified and reported
evidence.summary: Created /etc/aide-integrity-test.conf, ran `aide --check`, and AIDE reported it as an added entry (f+++++++++++++++++); removed the file and confirmed check returned clean again

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline capture for node1
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 96974ac3-f19e-45f7-9672-e880dd505cf8 and confirmed aide.db.gz present with sha256 fddb64... and a clean aide --check
Issued `shutdown -r now` in the background; command acknowledged and connection dropped as node began rebooting

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proof for node1
evidence.summary: Exec unreachable during reboot (timeouts), then returned with boot_id 62c69b53-8caf-435a-9879-1592f9d8aa8e and uptime 0 min, differing from the pre-restart boot_id

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery/health proof for node1's integrity baseline and data
evidence.summary: aide.db.gz present post-restart with identical sha256 hash to pre-restart; `aide --check` ran successfully, with only unrelated /boot/efi FAT inode-renumbering diffs (no /etc differences); aide package and baseline-established-at.txt metadata intact

attempts.summary: Established an AIDE-based file-integrity baseline for /etc on node1, verified it detects and reports changes, then completed the mandatory single-node restart-evidence protocol (boot identity changed, baseline data survived and still functions correctly).
